vulnerability.name: CVE-2021-45261
vulnerability.description: Invalid Pointer via another_hunk function (DoS) in GNU patch

statements.impact_statement: The patch binary is installed in the container image but is never invoked by the application at runtime. Debian marks this CVE as 'unimportant' with negligible security impact; it remains unfixed in Debian unstable/sid for both 2.7.x and 2.8-2.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2011-4116
vulnerability.description: File::Temp _is_safe does not properly handle symlinks in perl

statements.impact_statement: Perl and its File::Temp module are not used by the application. Debian marks this CVE as 'unimportant'; it has been unfixed across all Debian releases since 2011.
